functions.name: QTY
functions.description: Returns the live quantity for a StudIQ dimension group.

parameters.name: display
parameters.description: length, area, wall_area, volume, count, or perimeter

functions.name: MEASUREMENT
functions.description: Returns the live quantity for a single StudIQ measurement.

functions.name: FRAMING
functions.description: Returns the matching-timber lineal metres for a framing group (excludes lintels).

functions.name: LINTEL
functions.description: Returns the total lineal metres for a specific lintel size in a framing group.

functions.name: RATE
functions.description: Returns the unit rate for a StudIQ rate library entry.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Rate ID (shown in the StudIQ task pane)

functions.name: CONST
functions.description: Returns the value of a named project constant.
